A bilingual project memory workflow that records project metadata, targets, current status, completed work, pending work, next actions, archive history, and AI handoff notes at project start, checkpoint, wrap-up, or handoff.

一个中英双语项目记忆工作流 Skill，用于在项目启动、工作中段、收工或交接时保存项目元数据、目标、当前状态、已完成事项、待办事项、下一步计划、归档历史和 AI 交接信息。

Upgrade Introduction / 升级说明

This is the upgraded version of the previous Chinese and English Daily Workflow editions; going forward, both language editions will be maintained together in this single bilingual package.

这是此前中文与英文 Daily Workflow 两版的升级版；以后中英文版本会合并在这个双语包里统一维护。

Version 2.0.0 introduces a project-local, context-compressing, bilingual workflow manager:

- Adds context compression at checkpoint, wrap-up, and handoff, storing only essential info for user and next AI.
- Unifies start/checkpoint/wrap-up/handoff flows with concise, actionable summaries instead of full transcripts.
- Modernizes file structure: Docs/ directory with TARGET.md, STATUS.md, COMPLETED.md, PENDING.md, SCHEDULE.md, and optional HANDOFF.md.
- Supports both Chinese and English trigger phrases and configurable workflow triggers in Docs/CONFIG.md.
- Strongly focuses on clear AI-to-AI and user handoff, improved privacy, and reduced context bloat.
- Includes initial project security policy (SECURITY.md) and new agent configuration file.

初始版本 1.0.0

功能介绍：
- ✅ 支持「开工啦」触发词，自动读取项目状态
- ✅ 支持「收工啦」触发词，自动保存工作进度
- ✅ 自动管理 Docs/ 目录下的5个核心文档：
  - PROJECT_TARGET.md (项目目标)
  - PROJECT_STATUS.md (项目进度)
  - COMPLETED_JOBS.md (已完成工作)
  - PENDING_JOBS.md (未完成工作)
  - NEXT_STEPS.md (下一步计划)
- ✅ 自动创建缺失的目录和文档（使用标准模板）
- ✅ AI-to-AI 无缝交接，保留完整项目上下文
- ✅ 适用于多 AI 协作的项目管理场景

适用场景：
- 每日工作开始/结束时的项目状态管理
- 多人/多 AI 协作时的上下文传递
- 需要详细工作日志的项目管理
